articleTitle: Safety Assessment of Highly Automated Vehicles Using Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: article analyzes regulatory documents in the field of operation and safety assessment of highly automated vehicles. Integrated security components of highly automated vehicles are given, key factors are analyzed. Technology “Digital Twin” and its areas of application are described, relevance of using this technology for monitoring highly automated vehicles safety throughout the life cycle is substantiated. Structure of safety assessment using a digital twin is presented. Procedure for creating a digital twin of an experimental highly automated vehicle is described, results of field and virtual tests are presented and analyzed. Measures are proposed to increase adequacy degree of digital twin to a real car, conclusions are formulated, and tasks for further research are indicated.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Characteristics of the Traffic Flow and the Structure of Vehicles on the Energy Consumption and Ecological Safety of Passenger Transportation : case of Vologda, Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to clarify the applied indicator of “dynamic vehicle dimensions” characterizing the size of a section of a city street occupied by a car during its movement. This indicator directly affects the value of the “dynamic passenger size”. In the case of relatively free traffic during between-peak times and when driving during rush hour, the indicators change quite a lot due to changes in average speed, deceleration during braking and the distance between cars. For the above cases, the specific values of energy consumption, travel time and financial costs for the movement of a conventional passenger by different modes of transport were calculated: a car, a bus on traditional fuel, a trolleybus, an electric bus, a bicycle and an electric scooter. The total contribution to environmental pollution with the current structure of the traffic flow has been determined and a forecast calculation has been made when it changes with an increase in the share of electric transport. The resulting refined mathematical model of energy consumption for the movement of one passenger, with refined variables, makes it possible to predict the effect of changing the structure of the traffic flow and its characteristics to assess promising approaches to reduce energy consumption in transport and improve the environmental situation.

articleTitle: Intellectualization of the Monitoring Process of Street and Road Network Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article substantiates the necessity of intellectualization of the monitoring process of street and road network facilities using modern mobile trail labs, which is caused by the high labor intensity and considerable length of monitoring objects, a large number of measurable parameters, and the need for rapid processing of large amounts of information. It is proposed to use data mining methods for intelligent data analysis and prediction of pavement strength, which allow solving problems of classification, regression, clustering, and prediction using artificial intelligence methods. The results of forecasting the longitudinal and lateral evenness, cracks, and road patches are presented. An original technology for a comprehensive assessment of the transport and operational condition of the road network based on developed modern high-tech equipment, which can be used for all types of inspections, is proposed. It is shown that the introduction of decision support systems for the intellectualization of the monitoring process of street and road network objects will make it possible to increase the technological efficiency of repair activities, analyze defects using a knowledge base, make a reasonable choice of road construction materials and technologies, and manage the repair work, which will allow the application of artificial intelligence methods in the promising area of decision-making on the repair of street and road networks, based on the results of diagnostics obtained by trail labs.

articleTitle: Increasing the Accuracy of Sound Signal Spectral Estimation According to the Properties of Hearing Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Audio signal is increasingly being used in the automobile industry. The article considers problems of matching the spectral estimation of sound information signal with the human auditory analyzer properties. It has shown that existing methods of spectral analysis of audio signals do not provide acceptable accuracy. The main requirements for the sound broadcast signal spectrum analyzer are formulated. Based on the multiple spectrum shift analysis method, a comparison of amplitude frequency response of “OPTIMOD” and “ARGO” audio processors is given showing the multi-band processing of the “OPTIMOD” audio processor. The possibility of sound system evaluation with the accuracy approaching human auditory analyzer properties is shown.

articleTitle: Road Construction Enterprise Management Model Based on Hyperautomation Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article examines the main trends in the development of enterprise management technologies as the basis for the model of hyperautomation of business processes, taking into account the trends in the development of technologies. Management at the level of improving the manufactured product can be further based on the Internet of Behavior, the use of common experience, hyperautomation, the ability to carry out the management process from anywhere in space. At the same time, it becomes necessary to carry out computations that increase privacy and the development of a cybersecurity network. Hyperautomation of technological cycles requires less time, fewer production process failures occur, and less time is required for elimination, repair and maintenance of equipment. At the same time, the costs of introducing innovations have so far turned out to be quite high relative to the benefits obtained from their use. Practice shows, however, that only the latest developments are particularly expensive, and over time, the cost of technologies of the previous generation will quickly and significantly decrease.

articleTitle: Drivers’ Electrocardiosignals Analysis for Arrhythmias’ Predictors Registration
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main goal of this research is to confirm the opportunity to detect low amplitude arrhythmias’ predictors in electrocardiography signals (ECS) registered from automobile driver’s hands (I standard lead). Heart’s ventricular late potentials (VLPs) are estimated as sought markers. The following tasks are solved in this work with the purpose to achieve the main goal:•Evaluation of low VLPs presence or absence by High-Resolution electrocardiography algorithms’ application (Simson’s method) to signals registered by orthogonal leads X, Y, Z;•Decision-making criterion design with subsequent its application to detect VLPs presence or absence in signals registered by I standard lead.300 signal records registered from 97 patients with myocardial infarction are analyzed. Low amplitude arrhythmias’ predictors are detected in 6 cases. Initial estimation of decision-making criterion threshold is done to signals with detected low amplitude predictors. Filtered QRS-complex time parameter is evaluated: its threshold is 64 ms. Practical significance of this research is that VLPs registration due ECS analysis from vehicle driver’s hands will be useful for health’s preventive measures and will help to decrease a probability of TA emergence.

articleTitle: A Technological Management Concept in Digital Logistics
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The constantly advancing times bring with them the need to perceive the approaches to the management of transport and logistics enterprises in a new way. This article attempts to reorient the existing management concept towards a digital transformation of modern business technologies. The digital age requires a fresh perspective on transport and logistics management. It will be based on classic management concepts with adjustments for the present.

articleTitle: The Use Intelligent Electronic Hitch for Vehicle Management
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses intelligent electronic hitch for vehicle management. Machines equipped with intelligent electronic hitch can be in a column or move independently of each other. This management method is an innovative technology and differs from traditional management methods. The input and output parameters of electronic hitch are fuzzy linguistic variables. This allows for a more flexible control mechanism compared to an algorithm using variables represented in the traditional way. Each fuzzy linguistic variable can take a value that characterizes the level of its uncertainty. This representation allows you to get additional opportunities for managing this variable and expands the capabilities of the entire control mechanism. In addition, intelligent electronic hitch has a separate input parameter to represent the level of uncertainty of the entire set of input parameters. Intelligent electronic communication can process five levels of uncertainty, including deep uncertainty. The analysis of the fuzzy inference surface allows us to obtain an optimal control strategy. Intelligent electronic hitch uses multi-agent technologies. The set of machines is considered as an agent system CDPS (Cooperative Distributed Problem Solving). Two models of agent behavior are proposed - reactive and proactive. The implementation of the self-organization mechanism based on the joint use of fuzzy inference technologies and multi-agent technologies is proposed. The application of the intelligent electronic hitch provides a control mechanism that implements technologies of self-organization and processing of deep uncertainty. Such a system can be used both when driving in difficult conditions and for organizing traffic in smart town.

articleTitle: Methodology Development for Assessing Automatic Emergency Braking Systems, Taking into Account Accidents Statistics Analysis with Unprotected Road Users
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Article considers road traffic accidents (RTA) statistics with collision with pedestrian in 2020 in the Russian Federation. Information analysis about road accidents in the Republic of Ingushetia and the Chechen Republic has been carried out. Types of tests of automatic emergency braking systems (AEBS) with preventing collisions with pedestrians’ function are proposed. AEBS tests are planned to be carried out during the day and night without artificial lighting. It is proposed to use a pedestrian model developed at the Automobile Department of the MADI as a moving target during testing. System for assessing AEBS effectiveness when working on the goal of “adult pedestrian” is proposed. Tests results of car Toyota RAV4 AEBS effectiveness, carried out according to developed method, are presented.

articleTitle: Transport Industry Digital Development Index
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Digital transformation of the transport industry is a necessary element of the development of the Russian economy. The spread of digital technologies determines the trajectories of economic and social development and leads to fundamental changes in the life of the population. Correct interpretation of trends and their meanings makes it possible to increase the efficiency of transport market entities and gain competitive advantages in the short term. A characteristic feature of the current stage of world economic development is the increasing role of digitalization. The article analyzes the current development of the digitalization processes of the transport ecosystem and its development prospects. In the course of the analysis, the existing difficulties that hinder the implementation of digitalization processes were identified. Based on the results of the analysis, it was concluded that there is no assessment and indexing system in transport. The article proposes a systematic approach to the formation of an assessment of the level of digitalization of the transport and road complex.

articleTitle: Social Resources Realizing the Potential of Technical Intelligentsia in the Automobile and Road Transport Complex
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The authors refer specialists with higher technical education, engaged in production, as well as in the development of an intellectual product for the development of science and technology, to the technical intelligentsia. These highly qualified specialists are leading in the automobile and road-transport complex in the issues of creation and functioning of intelligent systems. From a number of social resources of technical intellectuals (professional, value-based) stand out the intelligentsia ones, based on a high level of education and scientific activity. Theoretical developments and empirical studies have allowed to analyze the basis and main directions for the development of intellectual potential of technical intelligentsia: integration of higher education, science and production; development of information technology; artificial intelligence as an integral part of innovation; work with Big Data; social responsibility of technical intelligentsia for the decisions taken.

articleTitle: On-Board Intelligent Information System for Diagnosing Faults in The Ignition System of a Passenger Car
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: this article discusses the mathematical description of the processes of formation and propagation of electromagnetic interference arising in the car ignition system. The development of a concept, an integrated mathematical model and a technical solution in the field of creating an intelligent information system for diagnosing a malfunction of the passenger car ignition system with an internal combustion engine according to the parameters of the electromagnetic interference level is presented. The proposed technical solutions have passed experimental testing according to the criterion for classifying the electromagnetic emission level depending on the capacity of the noise suppression capacitor, and the mathematical model has confirmed its adequacy. The use of intelligent sensors in the diagnostic system allows to reliably determine the absence of an interference suppression capacitor, therefore, such classifiers are able to determine the most probable cause of an increased electromagnetic interference level almost instantly based on diagnostic data.

articleTitle: Data Transmission Algorithm in the IP Communication Networks Integrated Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The work is devoted to the development for data transmission algorithm in the IP communication networks integrated optimization method. The developed algorithm provides for the network parameters assessment and optimization in simultaneously with data transmission over it. The main estimated parameters are the transfer and delay matrices, and the optimized parameters are powers of access points and subscribers. According to this algorithm, the network parameters optimization is carried out when their estimates change and includes a dynamic network planning. The effectiveness of the application of the developed algorithm is shown, which provided a decrease in the load and an increase in the throughput of the Wi-Fi network deployed in the room.

articleTitle: Database of the Results of Monitoring the Street And Road Network Facilities
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Continuous monitoring with the use of specialized mobile trail-labs allows getting up-to-date data on the transport and operational condition of the urban street and road network, the efficiency of planning and quality of work on repair and maintenance of road facilities, as well as the quality of materials used during repair and restoration work. The design of the “Monitoring” database is performed, and its relational scheme is given. Based on the information collected during the monitoring in the “Monitoring” database, one can plan work on major and minor repairs of road and street network facilities, select materials and contractors to ensure high-quality repair and maintenance work, study the dependence of pavement condition on external factors with the development of measures to eliminate their negative impact.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of a Bus Route
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Creating digital twins of real bus routes requires developing adequate approaches to the modeling of individual processes occurring in the process of passenger transportation. The author proposes a simulation model of the bus route, developed in the AnyLogic environment, the scope of which is to clarify approaches to modeling processes of passenger getting on and off, the time of parking vehicles at a stopping point for passenger exchange, the probability of passenger refusal to board, the cost of passenger waiting time for boarding the vehicle.

articleTitle: Investigation of Traction and Adhesion Properties when Using Deicing Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Maintenance of highways in winter is an important part in improving road safety and preventing road accidents. In addition to accidents, poor quality of the road surface leads to large material losses. It is necessary to monitor the process of maintenance and subsequent quality control of the maintenance of the pavement. Studies conducted to determine the coupling properties of friction materials with car wheels show the effectiveness of the use of reagents in winter. In this work, the coupling properties of car wheels with the surface were tested when using reagents. During the tests, data were obtained on the basis of which mathematical modeling is carried out, which makes it possible to determine the critical values of traction resistance under operating conditions. The connections between the main technical parameters are obtained based on the analysis of the laws of mechanics and the theory of similarity of technical systems.

articleTitle: The concept of Choosing Methods for Testing Automated Driver Assistance Systems, Taking into Account their Impact on the Accident Rate
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A concept is proposed for the selection of testing methods for automated driver assistance systems ADAS, taking into account the statistics of road traffic accidents in the Russian Federation. The stages of the choice of methods for testing the ADAS system are described, including the identification of typical scenarios of road accidents and their attendant conditions, the formation of test scenarios and criteria for evaluating the effectiveness of the system under study. An example of the implementation of the proposed concept when choosing a methodology for testing advanced emergency braking systems of AEBS is given.

articleTitle: Hyperautomation of Construction Materials Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper describes, how, in the most concentrated form, latest computer and manufacturing technologies become valuable assets for digitalizing calculations and designing technological processes for manufacturing building materials and structures. The system is based on the concepts of “Digital Factory” and “SMART Factory” and includes a set of technological equipment, information, hardware and software integrated into a industrial network. The system is scalable and includes digital subsystems for the preparation of concrete mixtures, systems for targeted distribution of concrete, access control subsystems, and jobs for management personnel. In accordance with the proposed concept, the optimum level of automation of information collection and processing is provided for generating control signals and transmitting them without loss and distortion to actuators in order to achieve the most efficient operation of the concrete plant.

articleTitle: Influence of the Piston Ring Shape in a Free State on the Efficiency of Sealing the Combustion Chamber
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: One of the most common reasons for failure of piston machines in general and internal combustion engines in particular, is a violation of the sealing of the “cylinder liner - piston ring” interface. This article provides an analysis of calculation methods highlighted in open literature, which showed that all known methods have their own errors due to generally accepted assumptions that significantly affect the accuracy of the calculation. For the method, noted in the sources as the most accurate of the known at a given time, an analysis of the results was carried out, which showed that it also contains inaccuracies.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Warning Based on Electrocardiosignals Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The aim of the work is to develop a method for processing biomedical signals for on-board systems to warn the driver drowsiness when driving a vehicle. A method for determining the state of drowsiness of a driver based on continuous monitoring of electrocardiosignals (ECS) is proposed and described. The method uses the phenomenon of the relationship between various functional states of the human body and the parameters of heart rate variability (HRV). It was found that the spectral parameters of HRV are the most informative for determining the state of drowsiness. The technique of their calculation with continuous monitoring of the ECS is described. The threshold level of HRV spectral parameters for detecting drowsiness of drivers with a normal heart rate (from 60 to 90 beats / min) was determined. The structural scheme of the driver drowsiness warning device, which implements the proposed method, is presented and described.

articleTitle: Estimation of Nitrogen Oxide Emission Reduction in a Boosted Truck Diesel Engine with Two-Stage Charging and Miller Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Power augmentation and reduction of toxic emissions, especially of nitrogen oxide (NOx), is a permanent challenge for internal combustion engines. Modern Euro-6 ecological standards for truck diesel engines have a very severe limitation of NOx emissions. To comply with it, a complicated and expensive SCR catalyst should be mounted. Using the Miller cycle may reduce considerably NOx emissions though in this case, the filling of engine cylinders with air drops dramatically which results in its power loss. Traditional charging systems with one turbocharger may not compensate for the cylinder filling degradation, therefore, two-stage charging systems are often used jointly with the Miller cycle which makes it possible to compensate for filling losses and obtain higher engine power. Operating parameters of a highly boosted truck diesel engine having a two-stage charging system with and without Miller cycle were forecasted using the AVL BOOST simulation complex. Turbochargers for the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> stages of the charging system were selected for the engine with and without the Miller cycle. Operation parameters of the diesel engine and its charging system were calculated. In case of the Miller cycle, the boost pressure was increased by 40% and emissions of NOx dropped by 50%. Power and fuel efficiency of the engine with and without the Miller cycle were close.

articleTitle: Study of High-Performance Chromium Electrolyte for Restoration of Automobile and Road-Construction Machinery Parts
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The conducted studies of high-performance self-regulating cold chromium electrolytes showed that they have a number of difficulties for implementation - the complexity of their organization and implementation in production. As a basic high-performance chromium electrolyte we used the existing chromium electrolyte, whose productivity and current output falls, as well as the quality of the deposit decreases when the working temperature of the electrolyte exceeds 30°C. To solve this problem the composition of the electrolyte was changed, which allowed to eliminate the existing drawbacks. As a result of the research and the results obtained it was found that the new composition of chromium electrolyte on the basis of the existing one in the working temperature range of 18-35°C would increase the current output to 50% and increase the deposition rate to 450 mkm/h, with improved quality of coatings in thickness, while maintaining high microhardness and wear resistance. Therefore, the developed electrolyte will be possible to use for restoration of parts of motor vehicles and road-construction machinery.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Controlled Railway Crossing Capacity Evaluation under Condition of Poisson Traffic Input
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: For a regulated railway crossing at one level, a mathematical model has been developed to estimate its throughput capacity. With the help of this model, the throughput capacity of the traffic flow along the road crossing the railway tracks is estimated, defined as the maximum intensity of the traffic flow, at which the specified requirements for the distribution of the time spent by the vehicle in the queue before railway crossing are met. The model is a queuing system with an unreliable device. Approximate formulas for calculating the average value and distribution of the time spent by the application in the queue and the length of the queue are proposed. As an example of using the developed approach, an estimate of the capacity of a particular railway crossing is obtained.

Author Keywords: queuing systems with an unreliable device

articleTitle: Simulation Model of Lane Change Maneuvers Based on Generalization of ECA 184 and Deterministic-Stochastic Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Purpose of work: consideration of the issues of modeling the traffic flow on the highway on the basis of the deterministic-stochastic approach developed by A.P. Buslaev. The mathematical model of traffic flow on the highway, based on the deterministic-stochastic approach, was developed and the corresponding simulation model was created. In accordance with the deterministic-stochastic approach, the velocity of traffic flow is represented as a sum of the deterministic component, which corresponds to the velocity of the model’s cellular field on which the particles move, each of which corresponds to a vehicle, and the stochastic component, which corresponds to the average speed of the particles in the field. The cellular field consists of circular sequences of cells. Each such sequence corresponds to a lane. There are two types of particles, one of which (the first type) corresponds to fast and the other (the second type) to slow vehicles. Particles of different types differ in the probability of moving to a free cell on the time tact. In addition, it is assumed that a particle of the first type occupies one cell, and a particle of the second type two cells. If we assume that all particles belong to the first type and the probability of moving to another lane is zero, then the rule of motion on the cellular field corresponds to the rule of motion of the cellular automaton ECA 184.

articleTitle: Elimination of Isoline Drift when Analysis of the Electrocardiosignal of the Vehicle Driver
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper considers a new method of processing an electrocardiosignal (ECS), which increases the reliability of its analysis. The purpose of our work is to eliminate the drift of the ECS isoline during automatic analysis of the ECS. This interference is one of the difficult-to-remove ones and the solution of this problem significantly increases the accuracy of the subsequent analysis of the ECS in a number of tasks, especially in the task of detecting cardiac arrhythmias. To solve this problem, we propose to extract the isoline drift signal from the recorded ECS using spline approximation based on the regularization method. To do this we use the signal samples at the TP-segments of the ECS as reference points for the spline. This method uses a number of natural approaches to approximating such functions that generate splines whose values are given with errors. Then we subtract the allocated signal of the isoline drift from the registered ECS. The implementation of the proposed method for eliminating the isoline drift using spline approximation based on the regularization method on real ECS showed that the residual drift does not exceed 0.97% of the initial one with an increase in the isoline drift frequency up to half the heart rate. This allows us to conclude that the accuracy of the ECS parameter estimation obtained using the proposed method is increased in comparison with the “classical” method of spline approximation. The originality of the proposed method lies in the fact that the samples of the TP-segments of the ECS were used to construct a spline approximation of the isoline drift.

articleTitle: Financial Analysis as a Franchising Tool in Modern Conditions of Digitalization of the Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Pandemic conditions and business constraints related to the spread of coronavirus infection have also made adjustments to the basic principles of franchise agreements. The justified transition to digitalization has adjusted the existing forms of running a business in franchising as well. New ways of communication between franchisor and franchisee have required the updating of franchising principles. Financial analysis tools allow timely reaction to changes in economic conditions, in particular within the framework of the franchise agreement.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Convergence Domain of the Backpropagation Algorithm for Training the Perceptron in Pattern Recognition in the Problems of Technospheric Safety of Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The efficiency of the backpropagation algorithm is considered in relation to the problem of training a three-layer perceptron with two input and two output values. To activate perceptron neurons, a logistic function with parameter a was used. The learning process was carried out using many of 10,000 examples and lasted for 100 epochs. Two training modes are considered - deterministic, in which the sequence of training examples in each epoch is the same, and stochastic, when the training examples are randomly reordered before each epoch. Based on the simulation results, the advantages of the deterministic mode over the stochastic mode were not revealed, which makes it possible to recommend deterministic learning for practical use as it is simpler in computational terms. It is shown that the best training quality is achieved when using 8 neurons in the second hidden layer, when the average relative error of the trained perceptron is less than 0.003. With a decrease in the number of hidden neurons, the quality of learning decreases, with an increase, the range of learning parameters narrows, at which the learning process converges to a satisfactory small error, while the likelihood of an imbalance in synaptic weights increases. With the learning rate parameter values of 0.95, the best quality indicators and the minimum duration of their oscillations between epochs were obtained; a higher rate of convergence of the learning process was recorded. The influence of the parameter a on the quality of training is investigated for its values up to 3.375 inclusive. When the size of the second hidden layer is no more than 8 neurons, an increase in a leads to a decrease in the average error of the trained perceptron. In perceptrons with 16 or more hidden neurons, the convergence region of the algorithm shifts towards small a values (no more than 1.125 for 32 neurons).

articleTitle: Implementation on Sobel Field-Programmable Gate Array Detector for Identification of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this article implementation process of the camera from the integrated field-programmable gate array or FPGA for problems of identification of the vehicles used on the automated points of weight and dimensional control by search of edges of the object in the detector Sobelya method is considered. In development process in the verilog language the main parts of interaction of the camera with the personal computer, for carrying out binarization of the image and also for its frequency filtering were described. The Fourier transform involves a large number of operations, which requires a large amount of computing power. To get around this limitation, the article discusses fast Fourier transform algorithms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Residual Life of Construction Machinery Hydraulic Cylinders by Means of Simulation Results
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Safety and efficiency of use of the construction equipment are defined by the level of reliability of the basic structural elements and systems of machines. Modern construction machines are equipped with the multipurpose hydraulic systems of the drives equipment working under trying conditions. The hydraulic drive of the construction machines is a complex system which is exposed to a set of dynamic loads of variable character and works in the conditions of aggressive external influence. Reliability of machines in many respects is defined by indicators of operability of the hydraulic equipment which is critical on non-failure operation. It is necessary to perform technical diagnostics to determination of machines condition, a residual resource and prevention of malfunctions. The article discusses the issues of determining the residual resources of hydraulic cylinders based on the results of simulation. In the course of the research, the methods of Reliability Theory, mathematical statistics and simulation were used. Predicting the residual resources of the hydraulic cylinders of construction machines is necessary to improve operational reliability, reduce downtime and reduce maintenance and repair costs.

articleTitle: Diffusion Of Digitalization In The Customs Sphere Through Electronic Document Management
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article adresses on the topic of the transition of all spheres of activity to electronic document management. In particular, the statistics of positive results on the transition to electronic customs declarations in the customs sphere is given. The article illustrates the problem of organizing electronic commerce and presents the problems that almost all organizations face when introduction of paper document management. The authors give a practical example as an argument of the further development of electronic document management. The introduction of electronic document management will have a faster application and use in conditions of a pandemic.

articleTitle: Mobile Road Rut Detection System with Mandatory Access Control Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Defects of the roadbed are serious problem, that can damage a vehicle or injure passengers. In this regard it is important to develop an intelligent transport systems (ITS) for collecting, analyzing and displaying roadbed rut data, while ensuring the required level of data protection. The paper presents a client-server mobile system “SIMKA” designed for detecting and monitoring rutting within the Moscow road network on the basis of a smartphone and a mobile laboratory with a profilometer. The system allows registering the road rut, transmit data about it to the server, process and record it in the temporal database using Mandatory Access Control data protection.

articleTitle: Building Information Modeling of Highways on Maintenance Stage
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Initially Building Information Modeling (BIM) originated as the development of computer-aided design (CAD) [1]. It was intended to be used only for the designing phase of building construction. Later, BIM technology was expanded for the construction stage and partially for the facility management. In the case of BIM adaptation for highways (as well as for many other infrastructure facilities, called “linear” construction objects in our country), data models used in the design and maintenance are traditionally different, which required a long comprehensive revision of approaches. In this article, we will try to formulate the main elements of the BIM approach.

articleTitle: Questions of Transport Planning on the Example of the Northern and Far-Eastern Regions of the Russian Federation
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A stable system of territorial development largely depends on the effective operation of the transport complex. The transport system ensures the satisfaction of transport demand, which makes it possible to serve various economic processes of the life of cities/regions/agglomerations. In turn, ensuring the proper level of mobility when moving passengers and cargo significantly affects the quality of life of the population. The task of the development of the transport complex is to increase the availability of movement, including in matters of meeting demand at the level of international travel. The availability of a public transport infrastructure is an important prerequisite for the possibility of moving people and goods be-tween the functional and spatial areas of the territorial agglomeration. The improvement of the passenger and cargo transportation system, the development of the transport system of the Northern regions is the most priority task. To solve this problem, it is necessary to form regional transport planning documents. Transport planning allows you to ensure the development of infrastructure, which contributes to increasing the efficiency of the transport complex. The article provides a brief overview of the aspects of transport planning and reflects the experience of developing transport planning documents on the example of the Sakha Republic.

articleTitle: Methodology for Assessing Vehicles Delay at an Unregulated Intersection with Dedicated Lane
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Purpose of dedicated lanes design for surface public transport (SPT) is to reduce travel time and create the most comfortable conditions for users (passengers) in comparison with personal cars or other transport modes. One of the design problems is presence of right turns and pedestrian crossings on the route, which can largely determine SPT vehicles speed, which differ from projected one. Article presents a methodology for assessing pedestrians' impact on vehicle delays at an unregulated intersection with dedicated lane for SPT vehicles based on probabilistic model. Simulation results showed that model with high accuracy corresponds to traffic with a low intensity of pedestrian flow. On the basis of obtained results, recommendations were proposed to minimize vehicles delay at unregulated intersections, including SPT on dedicated lane.

articleTitle: Comparative Levels of Autopilotation of Transportation and Technological Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The share of cars, rail transport,transport and technological vehicles with autopilot is increasing every year.At the same time, all researchers believe that autopilot scenes on public roads are much more complicated and dynamic than in agriculture and rail transport. The main difference between autopiloting transport and technological vehicles from autopiloting cars is that cars move along a compiled route along the road, and transport and technological machines onthe field by the method of parallel movement. Tests of machine and tractor units using precision farming systems were carried outunder the conditions of KazNIIZIR LLP in accordance with the relevant GOSTs. Driving standards have been adopted,including 6 levels. The article shows the levels of autopilot for transport and technological machines, cars, tractors and combines performing operations in the field: from its absolute absence (0level) to full autopilot (5-level).

articleTitle: Localization of Meaningful Interfaces “Human – Artificial Intelligence” with Respect to Human Safety
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses various interfaces in vehicles, their types and purposes, as well as the impact of each type of interface on safety. The classification of interfaces “human - artificial intelligence” from the standpoint of significance and the possibility of influencing safety when driving, stopping and parking a vehicle is given. The significance of the interfaces used in vehicles has been studied from the standpoint of traffic safety. Considered are the minimum requirements for the operability of the “human – artificial intelligence” interface influencing the active safety of the vehicle. The influence of the type of information message on the response time of the driver was investigated.

articleTitle: Problems of the Development of Vehicle Recycling
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Article analyzes the main approaches to solving problem of waste disposal in Russia. Article provides an overview of foreign and domestic sources on various aspects of issue of managing the final life cycle stage of vehicles. Article discusses environmental problems associated with development of automotive market in Russia. Automobile transport is one of the sources of environmental problems; article considers the strategy for development of industrial production to reduce environmental damage in the world. Problems encountered by auto-recycling process, role of recycling collection in this issue are considered. Issues that auto-recycling can solve are analyzed. A comparison with countries with the most advanced automotive industries has shown that a developed automotive sector is characterized by developed infrastructure which supports vehicle at all stages of its life cycle. Trends in magnitude of utilization collection are analyzed. Particular attention is paid to changes in 2020, in particular changes in coefficients used to calculate utilization fee, the list of vehicles for which utilization fee is applied. The role of the state in regulation of motor vehicles utilization process in the Russian Federation is considered. Analyzed situation with development of recycling vehicles to be disposed of. Programs of autorecycling cannot fundamentally solve problem of waste disposal that is currently produced in the city. The problem must be addressed using an integrated approach. Methods of disposal shall be provided at the stage of manufacture of the goods.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies for Analyzing Environmental Risks of Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Digital technologies, as well as their communication capabilities, are currently transforming traditional ideas about various fields of activity. In particular, digital technologies and trends in transport add new levels of interaction with society and specific users, and, accordingly, can have a significant impact on interaction with related areas of the economy, the external environment and the social sphere. New business models are emerging, leading to innovative technologies, including new online platforms for assessing the environmental impact of transport operations, and the volume of costs is significant for the business - up to 20% of all operating costs. Such significant costs must be properly managed, based on modern approaches and technologies. [1]. But the assessment of environmental risks, and accordingly, managing environmental costs can be complex. This is due to the fact that, firstly, it is difficult to determine both the actual costs incurred and the associated indirect losses. Second, once defined, some of the costs are difficult to isolate and identify. Third, costs may need to be monitored, but this can only be done if they have been correctly identified and ranked in order of importance. This article is devoted to the study of modern digital technologies in the analysis and assessment of environmental risks, as applied to transport facilities, and in particular, road transport infrastructure. The relevance of the problem is due to the acceleration of changes in the external environment of transport throughout the world, which determines the need to change the approach to the environmental risk management system. The article provides statistical data on this problem, and also considers the prerequisites for improving the risk management system in transport, which today is defined as one of the main tools for ensuring sustainable development of the economy of any country. It is pointed out that it is necessary to take into account the tendencies of changes in the prerequisites of risk management, which leads to the transformation of the management system of the transport industry towards a wider use of modern digital technologies [2]. Considered are modern approaches based on the foresight approach of risk management [3], which is proposed to be carried out at three levels: operational; tactical and strategic. We hope that this article will give a clearer idea of what environmental risk accounting is in relation to transport infrastructure facilities.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Tendentious Developing of the New Materials Used in the Production of Traction Electric Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: increasing the specific characteristics of an electric motor through the use of advanced materials is one of the main tasks in the design of traction electric motors (TEM). With an increase of requirements for vehicles with traction electric drive (TED), the requirements for the power-to-weight ratio of vehicles with TEP are increasing. The task is to increase the specific power of electric motors with the need to reduce the weight and size characteristics. It is necessary to increase power and torque, as well as to achieve minimization of losses and an increase in efficiency [1,2]. The article presents trends and tendentious of materials for the production basic elements of traction electric motors.

articleTitle: Testing of Electromagnetic Interference Level by Means of Onboard Intelligent Measuring System as a Tool for Assessing Operating Quality of Passenger Car Electrical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: the car ignition system is a strong source of electromagnetic interference, and therefore the issues of diagnosing their level in order to monitor and develop measures for electromagnetic compatibility are of particular practical interest. This article presents the results of an experimental study of the performance of the onboard intelligent measuring system for diagnosing faults in the elements of the electrical complex of a passenger car. Particular attention is paid to the characteristics of broadband radio interference at the output of the car antenna cable and the related quality of radio reception, also the need for timely diagnosis of an increase in the level of electromagnetic interference during operation is shown. Using the onboard intelligent measuring system of the electromagnetic interference level on the example of a LADA family car the interrelation of this level with the quality and reliability of the antenna cable and body contact connection has been established.

articleTitle: Hardware and Software Complex for Measuring the Lateral Roughness of the Road Surface – Leader HSC
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Trail labs are widely used to identify the level of transport and operational condition of the road network. The systems installed allow measuring and determining most of the road parameters directly in motion. The article analyzes the approaches to measuring lateral evenness, track parameters, and the main factors affecting the vehicle movement mode. The main methods of measuring lateral evenness are described. It is shown that laser scanners are the most effective means of measuring lateral evenness by moving trail labs. A comparison of technical and economic indicators of systems for measuring cross-sectional evenness is performed. The paper proposes a scheme of the Leader hardware and software complex for measuring crosssectional evenness of the roadbed using laser scanning technology, which automatically calculates the height marks of the cross profile of the road surface with an accuracy of 1 mm at a width of 3.6 m, while the software makes it possible to automatically calculate the track depth. The main advantages of the Leader hardware and software complex are given, the choice of technical means and possible spheres of its application is justified.

articleTitle: Protection of Road Pavement from Storm Water Runoff by Means of a Subsurface Storm Sewer
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the issues related to the drainage of water from the roadway to prevent its penetration into the pavement. The article proves the necessity of drainage as an important component in solving the problems of durability and service life of road clothes. Examples of existing drainage methods are given. Attention is also paid to the changes in the legislation, according to which at present discharge of water collected from the roadway onto the terrain is prohibited, which makes it necessary to redirect the collected water quite a long distance to the treatment facilities. An analysis of possible options for drainage in accordance with the new requirements is made. A new method of water collection and removal that is notable for its simplicity, efficiency and low cost in comparison with other methods used for the same purposes has been proposed. The advantages of this method, as well as possible difficulties arising during its implementation, are described. Attention is drawn to the imperfection of the normative base linking the depth of laying of pipelines designed to take rain and storm water runoff with the depth of ground freezing. Recommendations have been given as for determining the rain water drainage system as a separate group which has no limitations due to the ground freezing depth.

articleTitle: Thermo-Chemical Treatment of Structural Steels in Different Types of Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper studies the process of gas nitriding of iron and steels in an electric discharge. Data were obtained on the acceleration of the process of saturation with nitrogen compared to traditional furnace nitriding. The rate of formation of both the nitrided layer as a whole and of the compound zone increases. At the same time, the process can efficiently proceed both with and without additional heating of the muffle. As controlling parameters fpr kinetics of the layer growth, the electric discharge current density and the temperature of heating the muffle are used. The regulatory effect of saturating environment parameters was studied during nitriding in a glow discharge.

articleTitle: Plasma Nitriding of Steels in Electrolyte Solution Combined with Diffusion Metallization
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The process of hydro-plasma nitriding is presented consisting in surface saturation of steels in low-temperature hydrostatic glow-discharged plasma generated in nitrogen containing liquid electrolyte. The method can be applied for strengthening of small machine parts made of carbon steels or low-alloyed steels for increase of wear and corrosion resistant of items working in corrosive and abrasive conditions (moisture, humor, sand, etc.). Processes of hardening of steels by nitriding in low-temperature electrolyte plasma combined with surface alloying by diffusion metallization by an alloying element (chromium, aluminum, vanadium, titanium, tungsten, cobalt, nickel, molybdenum, and niobium) are discussed.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of DCI Messages Decoding Method to Estimate the Information Load of the LTE Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article describes a method for increasing the accuracy of evaluating the information load of the LTE cell. The algorithm is based on three evaluation criteria. The method was probing with simulation on channels with AWGN and Rician fading. The modeling results provide to obtain the parameters of the algorithm such as maximum error number and threshold of appearance of RNTIs. Additionally, by these parameters, the algorithm of pre-processing of DCI messages was implemented. Improving the accuracy of determining the information load of the cell allows this information to be used by supervising organizations or when developing networks using dynamic spectrum sharing. Implemented algorithms were applied to analyze the signal from real base station LTE.

articleTitle: Methodology for Analysing the Technical and Economic Factors of Mechanisation in Aerodrome Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of methodology of technical and economic comparison of the newest concrete laying complexes in the construction of hard-type pavements on airfields. In particular, various means of mechanization of domestic and foreign manufacturers used in the construction of hard-type coatings are studied, their advantages and disadvantages are revealed. The analysis of technical and economic parameters performed according to this method showed that it’s more feasible to use Gomaco GHP 2800 set for the construction of hard coverings on airfields in Russia, than Wirtgen SP 94 set. This conclusion is justified by the fact that the concrete paving kits with electro-hydraulic drives of Gomaco, have a better speed of concrete paving, despite their higher rental cost, which significantly minimizes the financial costs associated with the construction of facilities.

articleTitle: The Study of Motorcar Time Intervals at Railway Crossings
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Railway crossings still remain one of the areas with the highest rate of accidents with acute effects on health of road users and high risk of death. Grade separation of railway and highway crossings allows to solve the problem of road safety in the most efficient way but it is very expensive. Feasibility studies of level or grade-separated railway and highway crossings is associated with necessity to define throughput of such sections of motor roads, which, in turn, requires to conduct experimental studies of motorcar traffic conditions. In order to determine recommendations concerning selection of railway-crossing arrangements, the authors conducted the experimental studies of motorcar traffic patterns at railway crossings of Moscow Region. Based on the studies, the values of motorcar time intervals at level railway-crossings were obtained. The results of the studies may be used to define throughput of highways and are recommended to be used for feasibility studies in the course of design of railway-highway crossings and to define throughputs of level railway-highway crossings.

articleTitle: The Use of Dimethyl Ether
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The transition to alternative types of fuel is considered, since in connection with the deterioration of the environment, this becomes a necessary condition for the environment. In this regard, in recent years, attention has been paid to the search for alternative fuels that would satisfy the conditions of the working process of a diesel engine, and also contribute to the rapid reduction of harmful emissions into the atmosphere. Currently, there are several varieties of alternative fuels for internal combustion engines. Among well-known fuels, such as natural gas, alcohols (methanol, ethanol), hydrogen, rapeseed oil, and others, the question of using dimethylether (DME) began to be considered. The issue of DME production is described, the effect of the use of DME is analyzed, conclusions are drawn about the expediency of its use.

articleTitle: Development of Hazard Class Determination Method for Substances Generated in Operation of Special-Purpose Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper presents a new approach to determining the specified hazard class of substances generated operation of special-purpose vehicles. This approach allows to minimize costs of operating the vehicles by significantly reducing environmental payouts. The main methods used were analytical studies using chemical processes simulations, feasibility study, physical and chemical methods of analysis. An algorithm is proposed for determining the composition of waste, where the component composition is determined following a simplified protocol. The proposed method for assessing the hazard of highly dispersed particles from combustion of energy-rich substances takes into account their dimension. The application of the proposed methods for determining the hazard class of waste and of highly dispersed particles allows to increase the accuracy of the assessment of the waste hazard and tends to downgrade the assigned hazard class, thereby significantly reducing operational costs for special-purpose vehicles.

articleTitle: Choosing Technologies for Use in the Development of Special-Purpose Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper presents the methodology developed for evaluating technologies used in the creation of special-purpose vehicles. This methodology allows to minimize costs when designing vehicles and during their further operation by reducing the risks of imposing sanctions due to non-compliance with the requirements of environmental legislation. The main methods used were analytical studies using methods of mathematical statistics, decision theory, feasibility study, physical and chemical methods of analysis. Several options for comparing technologies were proposed, depending on their complexity. As an example, a comparative assessment of waste disposal technologies using special-purpose vehicles was carried out. The assessment of technologies used in the development of special-purpose vehicles allows to make the most appropriate decision on their industrial use, taking into account the stricter requirements of legislation in the field of environmental protection and, in some cases, with limited resources.

articleTitle: Method for Determining the Maximum Allowable Pavement Rutting from the Condition of Ensuring the Safety of Traffic in Rainy Weather
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is devoted to the requirements for pavement rutting in force in Russian GOSTs and in some foreign countries. The article considers the methods and techniques for determining the rutting pavement using a computer program on any part of the road, and its parameters, which make it possible to determine the amount of material carried away as a result of abrasion, the thickness of the water layer in the rut during rain and the maximum slopes of the rut walls (left and right). The maximum rutting depth, depending on the speed of movement on the road, is determined in the article. Based on the experimental data obtained, the article concludes that with a rutting depth more than 14 mm, traffic safety cannot be ensured in the rainy weather at speeds over 160 km/h.

articleTitle: Development of a Test Algorithm and Evaluation of the Properties of a Metal-Cladding Additive
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the problems of using compositions to increase the durability of friction units of power plants with the use of metal-cladding additives, as well as through the constant enrichment of engine oil with copper elements during operation. The dependence of the durability and efficiency of the use of agricultural machinery on the physicochemical and operational properties of lubricants has been determined. The mechanism of action of the modifier and the parameters of the protective layer are proposed. An algorithm for conducting tests has been formed, and key measurable quantities have been highlighted. An assessment of the effect of a metal-cladding additive on the main operational properties of an internal combustion engine has been made. The class assessment of the indicators of the modifier’s work was carried out according to the point system. The influence of the modified engine oil on the quantitative indicator of combustion product deposits in the cylinder-piston group is considered. As a result of the study, the key features of the use of the modifier are highlighted.

articleTitle: Important Factors to be Concerned when Moving to Infra Building Information Modeling in Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Since 01.01.2022, all construction projects in Russia financed by the government of all levels must use information modelling technology. Implementation of Infra Building Information Modeling (InfraBIM) concept for road construction needs special attention to coordinate support issues. Requirements to coordinate systems at different stages of road lifecycle are discussed. Arguments regarding importance of unity of coordinate description paradigm and VOGS as instrument of that paradigm realization are provided.

articleTitle: Concept of Digital Leveling System of Construction Sites
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In connection with the acceleration of scientific and technological progress and the growth of labor productivity, road construction equipment is facing a difficult task. We are talking about a coherent, complex, productive work of equipment without loss of quality. Because of this, more and more often there is a technique with complex mechanization and automation. Among such equipment, machines for earthworks, namely auto graders, occupy a large specific weight. The road grader is a rather wide-ranging earth-moving machine that has earned its place in construction. This equipment has a number of advantages that are fundamental when choosing a construction unit for excavation on site. The relevance of this work is primarily related to the need to improve this technique, which will increase its productivity and reduce the specific gravity of energy consumption. Modernization of existing road graders will significantly affect the further development of construction equipment and will expand the boundaries of preparatory work of the roadway for future construction.

articleTitle: Digital Analytical Model for Estimating Sales Speed Delivery of Foreign Trade Goods by Road
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this article, it is proposed to consider one of the possible methods for assessing the commercial speed of road freight transport. It is necessary to systematically monitor the actual level of commercial speed of cargo transport engaged in the transportation of foreign trade goods. It is clear that for this we need appropriate methodological tools that allow us to adequately assess this level based on real data. In the case of cargo transportation by road in international traffic, a significant environmental factor affecting the time characteristics of transportation activities is the duration of the presence of vehicles in the area of the automobile checkpoint. It can be argued that this time is largely random. The specifics of international road cargo transportation is that road carriers on their way in the process of cargo delivery repeatedly cross the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union and the state border of Russia. Obviously, there is no systematic accounting of such time characteristics. An analysis of official open sources of information related to international road transport of goods did not reveal such information.

articleTitle: The Use of Rules Based on Fuzzy Logic to Automate the Work of the Driver to Control the Movement of the Vehicle Along the Route
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Urban passenger transport is currently considered by the administrations of large cities and megalopolises as the main tool for improving the difficult transport situation that has arisen due to the uncontrolled increase in the level of automation of the population. The problem, in this case, is the need to dramatically improve the quality of public transport services, by improving the regularity of vehicles on a schedule. This article discusses a bus driver assistance system that provides automatic control of vehicle traffic on a schedule. As a driver assistance system, an intelligent telematic controller based on the fuzzy logic technique.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Effect of the Working Fluid Density on the Characteristics of the Torque Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the results of experimental studies on the quantitative determination of the influence of the physical properties of the working fluid on the external characteristics of the hydrodynamic transformer of a special-purpose vehicle. The object of the study was a lockable hydrodynamic transformer with an axial turbine. The research method is experimental. For the first time, a liquid of increased density – 13FM was used as a working fluid. In the course of the study, the main technical and operational indicators were determined: the operating modes of the hydrodynamic transformer (gear ratio), the value of energy intensity, the transformation coefficient, the efficiency coefficient when using working fluids 13FM and I2OA. In the article, the graphs of the external characteristics of the torque converter clearly show the effect of temperature on the studied values.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Transport Factor in the Calculation of Durability of Road Pavements
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper considers the documents of technical regulation in terms of designing flexible road pavements, which were put into effect in 2021. The current approach to the design of flexible pavements was reviewed, and attention was paid to the consideration of special properties of non-cohesive granular materials when calculating the strength of the structure. In the analysis of these documents the experience of using the data received from the WIM (Weigh-in-motion) has been taken into account. The article presents graphs of the percentage distribution of vehicle axle loads in the flow, obtained by processing and averaging data from more than 20 automatic weighing stations in traffic. Proposals have also been made to assess the effect of the magnitude of the total number of design load applications to the pavement surface on changes in the properties of the materials used in the non-rigid pavement layers. These suggestions can be implemented both in case of theoretical approach and empirical approach. The authors have also offered the direction of the development of the existing design method in terms of the use of data on the freight traffic flow in the calculation of multilayered road pavement.

Author Keywords: the coefficient of conversion to the design load

articleTitle: The Use of Capacitive Sensors when Measuring Fuel Consumption for Warming Up Road Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This research work declares the need to carry out the procedure for warming up buses operated in air conditions of minuses temperature at transit agency, and describes the procedure for its implementation. The necessity of building the conditions which regulate fuel consumption during the heating is determined. The existing solution in the State Unitary Enterprise “Mosgortrans” for measuring the consumption of gasoline and diesel fuel (hereinafter referred to as motor fuel) for heating the fleet is described. Its disadvantages are presented. Various methods of modernization of the existing device for measuring the consumption of motor fuel for heating the fleet at the SUE “Mosgortrans” are considered and analyzed. A schematic diagram of a modernized device based on a digital capacitive fuel level sensor model R-7 for measuring the consumption of motor fuel for heating the fleet stock of the SUE “Mosgortrans” is presented. The design features of the device and test results are described. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Methodology for Comparative Evaluation of Performance of Improved Hydraulic Power Packs of Heavy-Duty Vehicle Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents the developed methodology for assessing the performance of vehicle transmission units (e.g., advanced torque converters) used in the creation of vehicles designed for lifting, moving and lowering loads, moving on roads of categories I, II, III and IV together with the load, without losing cross-country passability. One of the main directions considered in the article is to improve the maneuverability of mobile ground missile systems (MGMS) and, above all, their autonomous launchers (ALs). Traditional principles and methods do not allow to achieve a significant increase in mobility of ALs, as their maximum speed on roads of I-II categories does not exceed 40 km/h. In modern conditions, the transportation and installation equipment of rocket systems (TIE RC) are subject to high requirements for their mobility, cross-country capability and reliability. The TIE RC should perform their mission in any climatic conditions at any time of day and work in a wide range of soil and ground conditions, including overwatered, waterlogged soils with low load-bearing capacity. One of the areas of research in this topic is new combined types of transmission with improved performance characteristics and ways of working.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Recognizing the Main Characteristics of the Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article describes an intelligent system that determines the main characteristics of the traffic flow, such as the type of vehicle, car brand, intensity and density of the traffic flow. The main characteristics of transport flows are considered in detail, as well as the classification of transport flow models. It describes the advantages of using artificial intelligence to solve such problems, as well as describes the tasks, the purpose of the work and the relevance of this topic. The process of collecting a dataset (training, validation and test samples), preparing data for training, training a neural network, and also presents the results of the resulting intelligent system.

articleTitle: Method of Alloying Engine Oil with Complex Copper Compounds
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents a method of alloying engine oil with complex copper compounds, which can significantly reduce wear on rubbing surfaces and increase the reliability of the internal combustion engine by transferring copper from the alloy to the surface. A device for alloying engine oil with copper-containing elements has been developed. The process of copper cladding of surfaces of movable joints of machines and mechanisms is described. The dependence between the number of copper particles in the lubricating medium, the size of the copper element area and the ligand concentration in the lubricant is revealed. The study of steel samples for corrosion resistance in different lubricating environments has been carried out. The experiment to determine the dissolution rate of copper depending on the amount of ligand in the base oil has been conducted, as well as to determine the optimal amount of copper. The article analyzes the economic effect of using a metal-plating additive (MPA) in the operation of a vehicle.

articleTitle: Use of Polymer Materials for Temporary Driveways
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The work considers the use of mobile road plates for organizing temporary driveways during construction work. Often exploration and surveys, especially in sparsely populated areas, such as the Arctic and the Far North, are difficult to organize construction sites and temporary driveways. The use of mobile road plates in conditions of weakly bearing soils and marshes makes it possible to significantly reduce material and temporary labor costs, reduce the negative impact on the fertile layer and ensure the effective organization of both traffic and construction sites. The study presents the results of digital virtual modeling and field tests of mobile road plates.

articleTitle: Infrastructure and Monitoring of the State of the Road Network in the Northern Regions
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Climatic conditions of the North complicate the development of road infrastructure, but the strategic objective of the Russian Federation determines the need to develop areas to provide industrial enterprises and the population with products, goods and food. The problem of limited transport accessibility of the region is solved by creating transport flows, mainly land, but the peculiarities of the region determine the difference in the provision of roads dozens of times relative to all-Russian indicators. Application of intelligent systems in vehicles and formation of the system of monitoring of road network objects in the Arctic will allow to transport cargoes not in columns, but as needed, taking into account the specifics of roads made of snow and ice in winter period, since it is ground vehicles that take the main volume of cargo transportation.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of a Three-Dimensional Scene from its Projections in Computer Vision Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The problem of reconstructing a three-dimensional scene from its projections is one of the most urgent and studied among the problems solved by computer vision methods. Most often, such systems are implemented by creating geographically distributed complexes that require the transfer of a large amount of data between their components, which creates a large load on the transmission lines.
