Scene reconstruction using projections obtained from several observation points is a special case and is not always possible, especially when used in unmanned aerial vehicles or autonomous vehicles. To resolve these limitations, the possibility of using a computer stereoscopic vision system and a three-dimensional convolutional neural network capable of reconstructing a complete scene from a single image containing subjective characteristics of scene objects, such as color and depth, is considered in this work, creating its three-dimensional representation. The article describes the architecture and principle of operation of a neural network, and also builds a model of a computer stereo vision stand for image registration. An image formation algorithm is proposed for this model.

articleTitle: Development of a Platform for Road Infrastructure Digital Certification
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper considers the analysis of information environments and technologies suitable for the development of a platform for digital certification of road infrastructure. There is a description of the platform design: the tasks that make up the development are considered. The approaches to the implementation of the considered tasks are analyzed. Describes in detail the implementation of the platform components: preparing images for training a convolutional neural network, training a neural network on a prepared dataset, testing a trained neural network, software implementation of obtaining latitude and longitude from photo metadata in a user-friendly form, as well as in an easy-to-load cartographic service form.

articleTitle: Forecast of Decarbonization of Road Transport in Russia until 2050 in the Context of Digitalization and Expansion of the Use of Unmanned Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the main directions of low-carbon transport development in the conditions of post-pandemic development. Advanced transport technologies based on the use of information and communication systems, highly automated transport, diversification of energy sources for vehicles form a new social environment - they change the motivation of transport behavior, create a special digital environment for the driver of a vehicle, a road user, which will affect the quality life, mobility, traffic safety, environmental sustainability of transport during its transition to the trajectory of decarbonized development. These changes are taken into account in the scenario forecast of the number, intensity of use of the fleet of vehicles, the type of fuel (energy) used, direct and indirect emissions of greenhouse gases by Russian vehicles for the period up to 2050. When making forecasts, it is important to take into account the peculiarities of regional energy balances by the type of primary sources of electricity generation (coal, oil, natural gas, nuclear energy, hydropower, renewable energy sources), which affects secondary GHG emissions and the carbon footprint of transport activities in a particular region.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Accuracy of Digital Road Model Data to Increase Situational Awareness
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses technologies that can be used to ensure the accuracy of DRM data in order to increase situational awareness of self-driving cars. When providing situational awareness, it is important that information about statistical and dynamic objects is transmitted with maximum accuracy. Using examples of the main technologies used to determine dynamic objects, accuracy indicators and factors affecting the error are considered. In addition to this, a method of conducting experiments is described that allows to establish an accuracy sufficient for the safe functioning of unmanned vehicles. The final results of experiments conducted in accordance with the described methodology are presented.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies of Public Administration in Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The economy of any developed country is traditionally based on backbone industries, and the role of transport in jointly related industries is key in this list. The state of transport and transport infrastructure is a factor sign that affects many sectors of the national economy. The problems that have affected many areas of the economy have not spared the transport industry. The positive growth trends that the industry has shown in recent years (2018-2019) have been replaced by volatile and negative trends, as the industry has been one of the most affected by numerous restrictions on work in the COVID-19 pandemic (2020 and 2021). The article presents some statistical indicators characterizing transport activities and transport infrastructure. The article also presents an analysis of digital transformation (DT) in a number of areas of the economy, including transport, transport and road infrastructure, taking into account current trends in public administration. The relevance of DT is confirmed by profound changes taking place in all sectors of the economy and society, as a result of the introduction and integration of digital technologies into all aspects of human life. Digital technologies have an increasing impact on the way of life, work, communication and social interaction of an increasing part of the population, which cannot affect the methods of public administration in the economy, including transport. DT is expected to become a strategic vector of economic development over the coming years, and there is a significant need to be able to identify and address current and future problems for the economy and society. Due to the very wide range of interrelated areas that need to be considered when analyzing DT, an interdisciplinary approach was adopted to prepare this article, taking into account trends in areas related to transport, and it concludes with further directions for transport policy and research prospects. Regulation, including government regulation, is growing rapidly all over the world, and, accordingly, the requirements for compliance with the established rules are increasing, as is a priority task of government bodies “ [1]. The study of the foundations of foreign experience contributes to the analysis of the possibility of applying the most successful foreign practices in domestic conditions. Digital transformation (DT) can also have a synergistic effect on all transport, as it saves financial resources and can maintain optimal system performance in all key areas of transport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Digital Transportation Technologies for Formation of Bus Routes in the Conditions of a Megapolis
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The need for radical changes and measures to overcome negative trends in the provision of the population of the Russian Federation and meet the demand for bus transportation are reflected in a number of regulatory documents adopted by the Government of the Russian Federation and regional governments. The main one is “Transport strategy of the Russian Federation for the period up to 2030”. The document reflects the systemic problems of the operation of land passenger transport, one of which is the discrepancy between the qualitative and quantitative indicators of services provided by land urban passenger transport (NGPT), the actual requirements for ensuring the transport mobility of the population (TPM). All over the world, there is a tendency to introduce innovative technologies in the field of monitoring systems and centralized management of NGPT : hardware and software, communications, positioning, etc. The development of passenger transport management technologies in all developed and densely populated countries is moving towards the widespread use of modern infocommunication telematictechnologies, intelligent algorithms and devices installed on vehicles and roads. There is a clear tendency to an ever-increasing increase in the parameters of the state of objects of the passenger transport system assessed in the process of monitoring, an increase in the amount of processed information in peripheral devices installed on a vehicle or road, automatic distribution of the received information between the dispatcher, driver, passengers, automatic traffic control systems and others. participants in the management process. In practice, a new industry has emerged – intelligent passenger transport control systems integrated into the general traffic control system for all types of vehicles. Methods for the formation of the route network of NGPT should be based on decision-making models in information situations, characterized as situations with an uncertain state of the research environment. In this case, in order to identify objective data on the capacity of passenger traffic, it is necessary to use modern digital resources, which make it possible to produce “on-line” Monitoring of fuel supply, and the only possible way for the effective development of oil and gas fuel in the Russian Federation is the formation of a new industry-intelligent control systems for oil and gas, integrated into digital transport ecosystems (CTES). Therefore, the development of tools for solving control problems in the CHPP : new methods, mathematical models, algorithms, practical techniques based on them, is an important national economic task, and its solution is impossible without special scientific research.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effectiveness of the Simulation Model of a Wireless Communication System in Quasi-Real Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper discusses the capabilities of the original software, which allows simulating radio channels with a complex structure, due to both multipath and the presence of chaotic impulse noise. In addition, the work contains a listing of key blocks that implement these functions. The advantages of the developed software are the flexibility of its settings and the speed of operation, which allows for a significant reduction in time resources for the development of new radio-technical information transmission systems. Within the framework of the presented work, the results of modeling are presented, showing its performance.

articleTitle: Ash and Slag Waste – Secondary Raw Materials with Benefits for the Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Currently, the state is actively involved in changing and finalizing environmental legislation in order to implement the so-called “regulatory guillotine”. The changes are aimed at building a new system of state control, improving environmental legislation, tightening responsibility, as well as issuing normative and legal acts regulating the implementation of economic and economic activities. I must say that this is relevant, since, in particular, the waste accumulated until recently at an intensive pace has turned into a global problem of mankind.

articleTitle: Analysis of Known Methods for Improving the Operational Characteristics of Electric Current Rectifiers and Ways of their Further Development
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The project presents a developed technique for increasing the level of operational characteristics of energy converters using in structures of devices, the operating principle of which is based on the usage of the circular rotating magnetic field effect. The main methods used were studies of complex technical systems, the theory of electromagnetic multi-circuit devices with a circular rotating magnetic field, the theory of inverting and rectification of multiphase current. This project depicts the analysis of the main method of neutralization of higher harmonics in rectified voltage; the studies of the proposed methods for improving the operational characteristics of multiphase rectifiers were carried out. There were also proposed Mathematical models of: the toroidal grooving transformer, the frequency-multiplying converting transformer and the electromagnetic current converter transformer

articleTitle: The Virtual Digital Proving Ground for Carrying Out Tests of Road Arrangement Elements at Arrivals of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article considered the conditions of the researches on development of imitating modeling digital technologies of arrival errant vehicles processes on road arrangement elements, conducted for the last 10 years by scientific personnel of MADI, which allow to solve effectively now problems of optimization of road infrastructure for the purpose of safety, drop of expenses on design, tests and to carry out situation analysis of the road accidents. Based on models of nonlinear dynamics with use of 3D models of vehicles, infrastructures and road arrangement, with application of powerful program codes, digital software solutions give the chance of assessment of new approaches of road designs, which have to correspond to the new calls dictated by the extending use of artificial intelligence both in vehicles, and in elements of road arrangement. The complex of the developed validation digital models (Digital Twin) in total with standard techniques of their application is considered as the “virtual digital proving ground” (VDPG), which found big practical application in the road industry. The developed virtual complex is along with the Database and the Information - Retrieval System the important tool in the developed system of intellectual support of decision-making in the road industry.

articleTitle: Smart Road
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Relevance of this topic: the implementation of the smart road system in the road industry is relevant and significantly important in the whole world. This project pays off quickly, attracting the majority of investors. The constructed smart road works almost free of charge and performs all the assigned functions offline. The smart road is much cheaper and more efficiently shows itself from the practical side. The introduction of smart roads holds great promise as a solution to many environmental and social problems. Smart roads reduce congestion, improve road safety, and increase ride comfort for drivers.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Properties and Functions of Power Fluids for Hydraulic Systems of Special Purpose Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the results of the first stage of scientific research to determine the influence of the physical properties of the working fluid on the external characteristics of the hydrodynamic transformer of a special purpose vehicle. At the first stage of scientific research, an analytical review of the scientific and technical literature and the identified shortcomings during operation was carried out according to the requirements and characteristics for working fluids, taking into account their impact on the energy intensity of the vehicle torque converter. The paper characterizes fluids for hydraulic systems with an indication of their purpose, as well as the chemical nature of the products that are their basis. The basic physical properties of oils are given and the characteristics of the most common working fluids that are used in hydraulic drives of special machines in Russia and the USA are considered.

articleTitle: Method for Calculating the Parameters of a Cassette Brush Assembly, a Cylindrical Brush for Airfield Use
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper, a method for calculating the parameters of a cassette cylindrical brush of a universal airfield sweeper is proposed. The authors conducted preliminary experimental studies confirming the adequacy of the proposed calculation method. The results of calculations of the ratio of the angular and linear speeds of rotation of the brush, obtained during experimental studies, are presented in the form of a table. Calculations of the brush equipment were made to determine the main parameters of this node, as well as to determine the operability of airfield harvesting equipment in different operating modes (different densities of snow being removed, the presence of crosswind, etc.). The presented calculations will allow us to form recommendations on the operating modes of cleaning hard airfield coatings in the presence of various types of contamination on them.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Detection of Damaged Goods by Packaging State
publicationTitle: 2021 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of detecting damaged goods before delivery to the consignee, a method is proposed for identifying packaging in the cargo flow that has traces of deformation and other changes in appearance. As a result of the convergence of the skills and experience of specialists in the field of loading and unloading operations and the capabilities of artificial neural networks, it was possible to develop the concept of an intelligent system capable of detecting damaged packaging by analyzing the image received from CCTV cameras installed at the places of cargo operations. A convolutional neural network is recognized as optimal for solving the problem, and a description of the functions of its layers is given. In the course of the study, the existing methods for detecting damaged goods were described, characteristic signs of a change in the appearance of the package as a result of the influence of various negative factors were identified, the basic requirements for video cameras from which the image was entered into the neural network were formulated, and a scheme for placing video cameras and areas of image fixation was proposed and described. The proposed model can be implemented without installing additional expensive equipment and makes it possible to dispense with the introduction of accessory operations into the process of cargo transportation.
